explanation: Two bugs: (1) The window boundary was wrong — the spec says the interval is (time-window, time], which is open on the left, so events at exactly t-window should be excluded. The condition `q[user][0] < t-window` kept events at t-window; it should be `q[user][0] <= t-window` to remove them. (2) Rejected events were being appended to the queue, consuming capacity. Per the spec, only allowed events consume capacity, so `q[user].append(t)` should only execute when `ok` is True.
